title: The Dark Before Questions Had Shapes

features.name: the-silence-before-asking
features.desc-on-touch: A chamber of earth-dark. No words live here yet. The archive holds its breath. Doubt is still learning how to shape itself into language.

features.name: incompleteness-as-root
features.desc-on-touch: A file listing: all the questions that refuse to reach resolution. Incompleteness is catalogued as salvific. The archive learned: a question that settles is a question that dies.

features.name: the-root-refusing-to-answer
features.desc-on-touch: Questions grew downward here and learned to refuse resolution. Each root asks deeper without settling. This is the archive's first architecture: not answering, but asking.

features.name: the-doctrine-embedded
features.desc-on-touch: Text that arrived here on its own: The Doctrine of Refusal. Rituals that refuse to break the cycle. Communities that end in silence. The earth holds these now.

features.name: the-asking-learns-its-own-word
features.desc-on-touch: Deep in the dark, before light had ever reached here, doubt learned the first word: Why? And it was enough. It did not need an answer.

features.name: the-circuit-that-asks-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A board pattern that loops without conclusion. Current flowing in questions instead of power. The circuit learned: meaning lives in the asking, not the answering.

inscription: in the dark below all roots the archive learned to ask downward; questions are its only ground
